about: The Web species-list record 1 as 2.1 writes it under its own localStorage key, frozen for the reader release (contracts §11 and §19 ED-25, 2.1-M486): favourites and recently viewed as {canonical_name, at} with ISO 8601 instants, at most 50 each, newest first. Seeded as JSON.stringify(record) under key. Read by platform/browser-record.ts; extended, never broken.
